record_title: A diagonal-instability mechanism for a power-exponential product inequality
provenance: A second-variation analysis of the n-variable product inequality stated as Theorem 1.4 and parameterized as Conjecture 3.3 by Coronel and Huancas (2014).
limitations: The stable side of the local Hessian threshold is not a global theorem; the critical n=2 case and the global r=1 cases n=2,3 remain unresolved here. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Independent audit has not been performed.
